meta.name: add-discord
meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: 它会把 Discord 适配器复制进 src/channels/ 并注册,安装 @chat-adapter/discord@4.29.0,然后构建、跑注册测试;再引导你建机器人、粘贴 Bot Token、写入凭证并重启。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 接入 Discord 机器人频道时,或正处于 /setup、/manage-channels 流程中时接管。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 接入 Discord 频道
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖、构建并跑注册测试。

say.text: 这是我的 Discord Bot Token:xxx
say.note: 会校验格式,并读取应用 ID、公钥和你的用户 ID。

say.text: 把我的 Discord DM 设为对话地址

howto.what_en: It copies the Discord adapter into src/channels/, registers it in the channel barrel, installs @chat-adapter/discord@4.29.0, builds, runs the registration test, then guides bot creation, token paste, credentials and restart.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a Discord bot channel to NanoClaw, or while running /setup or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add the Discord channel to my NanoClaw setup.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, builds, runs the test.

say_en.text: Here is my Discord Bot Token: xxx
say_en.note: Validates it and derives App ID, public key, owner ID.

say_en.text: Make my Discord DM the conversation address.
say_en.note: Opens the DM and captures discord:@me:<channelId>.
